controls.label: Shape model
controls.description: Published prolate shape fit: 156 × 126 × 126 km. The third axis is assumed equal to the shorter measured axis. Voyager images constrain size and elongation but do not resolve a usable surface map. The standard gray grid marks unavailable mapped imagery; no terrain or albedo pattern is invented.
